reviews.review_title: Cool but would like grip toggle
reviews.review_description: Have reached out to devs but no response. Cool game (maybe even underrated?) but haven't played enough of it due to no grip toggle which makes this game difficult for me to play. Please add grip toggle option for accessibility.

The game looks and feels great and seems to br a quality experience, but even on EASY, I can't get past the first 5-8 minutes of the FIRST level (I have one eye and no peripheral of any kind in my working eye, making this already over-difficult game impossible even on what they consider" Easy")
So though the game is well made and grest fun for those who can somehow play it, I have no reason to keep it...

This game is SO hard, even on easy! I’ve been through the first level only halfway and can not figure out how to make it through 8 or 10 bullet tanks all shooting 40 bullets at you at one time from BOTH sides??!!! How’s that even possible at all?   

I did give this three stars ⭐️ because the graphics are outstanding and beautiful. The feel of the game is awesome but the difficulty is almost impossible. I’m not sure how anyone can get past the first section. It’s addictive trying but I always know I’ll ever make it past the duel bullet shooting tanks on both sides.  I won this game but, I have to give an honest review. Please tone down the crazy amount of shooters! It’s impossible at this level. 

Thanks

This game seems fun so far, but it's far too difficult, even on the easy setting. There is a point that I just can't seem to pass no matter how I approach it, but I'll keep trying.

Also, why have the guns wear out and die, only to have infinite spare sets of guns on your hips? Weird. Devs, why not just include a reload mechanic instad?

Baddies are too cartoonish. Come on, make me want to shoot them!

And no checkpoints?

This game could be amazing with a few simple tweaks, but comes up short so far.

reviews.review_title: Wow what a blast and a good workout!
reviews.review_description: Just got this today and I can already recommend it. In all honesty I thought the movement would possibly set off some motion sickness but it didn't seem to. I am however sweating like mad trying to avoid all the bullets. Once the action starts you barely get a breather. Just be careful in limited spaces otherwise you might end up taking out more than just the bad guys! :p
It's like a webVR game. The AI art fooled me I'll admit, but it has these cheapo SFX and terrible music.

Farcaster is an exciting VR rail shooter that shares similarities with Pistol Whip. The immersive gameplay offers responsive controls and engaging action sequences that make for a thoroughly enjoyable experience. As a fan of the genre, I'm thrilled with what the game currently offers and particularly excited to see how it develops in the future. Recommended for anyone who enjoys VR shooting games.
This game was unplayable but now way much better. Not as difficult as few days ago..... Amazing shooter game, will get u ducking and shooting.....thank you Devs for making it even greater❤️❤️

reviews.review_title: Fun but even on easy it’s annoying
reviews.review_description:
Fun game but if you die you jump way back having to redo a large boring part again and again and again and again. That doens’t make it hard but just plain annoying.  On the first campaign i had to redo the elevator thing 15 times just to die again in de last open area because you get shot out of  nowhere by a massive fire attack.  I choose easy - for a relaxing shooting time, not keep redoing parts.

Edit: even after trying a couple of more times it’s annoying. i get killed out of the blue and have to restart all over again. Going to delete this game.
Really cool game on the beginning was quite hard an challenging couldn't go far 😋, but ones you get a grip on the guns wooow
Very similar to pistol whip in gameplay but with fun and vibrant graphics, for the price you won't go wrong.

Under the radar type of game at a bargain price. Smooth and satisfying rail shooter but holy moly, it's waaaaaaay too difficult on normal difficulty. 

You'd need to be on ecstacy pills to be able to keep up as enemies are shooting at you all at once from 360 degrees. 

Seriously developers, reign it in on an update. Promote it better and I think it could be a popular little shooter. 3 stars until fixed

EDIT: After trying it on easy difficulty.......I change my rating to 2 stars! Still insanely difficult. 
Note to developers - hard does not equal fun. 
Remove at least 30% of the AI it's ridiculous

developer_response.body:
Ey ANGERSNIPER, thank you for your review! We've adjusted the difficulty of the Easy and Normal levels, aiming to make them more accessible. However, please remember that Farcaster is designed to be a challenging and fast-paced experience.

Here are some tips to help you master Farcaster:

Learn enemy spawn patterns: Enemies always appear in the same positions and at the same times.
Protect your head: It's your only weak point, so keep it safe!
Exploit enemy aim: Enemies aim for your head's current position. Duck, dodge, or move, then reposition to stay untouchable.

We hope this makes the experience more enjoyable for you!

reviews.review_description: this game has a very good mechanic, but will prove to be inaccessible to many because of the high difficulty, even on the “easy” level. I believe games like this that are best when you can enjoy a frantic shoot fest, and also have the option to enjoy a chill experience. I would be glad to up my review if this is addressed. ￼Thank you for your consideration of this.

reviews.review_description: Guys,when you learn how to dodge you become a killing machine!

Farcaster delivers an exhilarating VR experience that seamlessly blends classic FPS gameplay with dynamic on-rails action and wave shooting mechanics. From soaring on flying platforms to engaging in intense firefights, every moment is packed with action. The variety in gameplay—from paragliding and dodging enemy fire to exploring immersive military bases—keeps the adrenaline flowing and the gameplay fresh.

The visuals are stunning, and the interactive environments heighten the sense of immersion. The controls feel intuitive, making it accessible for newcomers yet challenging enough for seasoned VR gamers. Whether you're climbing structures or running through intense combat scenarios, the game consistently impresses with its creativity and execution.

Highly recommended for anyone seeking a thrilling and polished VR shooter. Farcaster truly pushes the boundaries of what VR gaming can achieve. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

An arcade-like experience, shooting at enemies with dual guns on far away planets. If you know what you are doing, there are some moments where you can unleash your inner gunslinger and shoot targets even from opposing directions with each of your guns, also trying to dodge at the same time and performing some crazy stunts if you put a bit of emotion on your moves.

Farcaster is an extraordinary VR experience that seamlessly blends classic FPS gameplay with thrilling on-rails action sequences and wave shooters. Riding futuristic flying platforms, taking down enemies, and dodging bullets from all directions are just a few of the exhilarating challenges this game offers.

The added ability to run and climb through stunningly designed military bases takes the immersion and excitement to the next level. The environments are visually impressive, and the dynamic mechanics keep you on your toes at all times.

With its recent availability on App Lab for Meta Oculus Quest 2 and Pro, Farcaster has become more accessible to VR enthusiasts, which is fantastic news. It's a perfect mix of fast-paced action and immersive storytelling.

In short, Farcaster is a must-have for any VR library, delivering an adrenaline-pumping and highly engaging adventure. Five stars well deserved!
Magnificient scenaries while shooting all Kindle of enemies.. When you finish you realise the physical exercise you have done!!!
It’s a demanding game, no doubt, but that’s what makes it so satisfying. You’ll need to learn enemy patterns and stay on your toes, but once you get the hang of it, beating levels feels amazing.

Get ready for an action-packed ride with this sci-fi on-rails shooter for Oculus 2 & 3! This game throws you straight into the action, guns blazing, with a weapon in each hand as you blast through waves of enemies in awesome futuristic environments. It's tough, but the thrill never stops!
Right from the start, it's super smooth. Thanks to the "on-rails" setup, you can focus on blasting away while the game takes you on a wild ride through epic sci-fi scenes. Dual-wielding is such a blast—you'll love the rush of dropping an overheated gun and instantly grabbing a new one. It keeps things moving fast and adds a cool layer of strategy that makes every second feel intense and fun.
If you love sci-fi and you're up for a fast-paced challenge, this game is a must-play. The dual-wielding guns, incredible environments, and smooth action make it a total adrenaline rush. If you want a VR game that'll keep you on your toes and make you want to keep coming back for more, this one is definitely it!

reviews.review_title: From Rookie to Gunslinger: The Rush
reviews.review_description:
Farcaster is a brilliantly simple yet exhilarating game. You pick up a weapon and shoot, feeling almost like you’re managing a queue with a tight margin to take down each target. The graphics are charming, and the music adds a lively, almost Saturday-night vibe that’s surprisingly fitting.

At first glance, the game feels punishingly difficult. Failures push you back quite a bit, making it seem frustrating. But then something clicks: you need to retry. The first thing you do is get off your darn chair—this isn’t a game for sitting. On your feet, you start dodging bullets, shooting freely, and suddenly, you’re in the zone. What once felt impossible becomes second nature, and before you know it, you’re grinning ear to ear as a full-fledged gunslinger.

This is a massively underrated game. It's worth more than £4.99, and is better than most higher priced games. If you like Pistol Whip and Star Wars, your gonna love this, and at £4.99 it's a no brainer. Really good for exercise too!  

It's a genius game and I would like to see the idea developed in the future, with more levels and maybe different guns.

Ps - I would pay for more levels if they could be added. 

Brilliant!!!

It’s always nice to find a hidden gem, under the radar this really hits the spot.
Great little FPS, with fabulous gun mechanics.
It’s starts off as a on rails shooter, then just as you think that’s hot, you can move around with the thumb stick.
The best bit is the guns, no reloading, just toss them away and take another two from your holster, it’s genius.
Great graphics and spot on shooting make , well done to the dev.this a really fun first person shooter.

I really enjoyed this, found it a good challenge.

Standing on a moving platform and moving through interesting landscaped and scenery… dodge incoming bullets whilst shooting enemies.

The graphics are nice, I like how you drop your weapons and get new ones instead of having to reload.

Like the designs in this game from the enemies to the scenery.

I think it would be easier if you play this standing, as it’s playable sitting down but harder to dodge the incoming bullets.

If you like on rail shooters and a challenge, then get this

So this arcade style, on rails shooter, gets fast paced real quick, so glad you can choose your style of game play, (easy was still hard lol).  As it’s on rails for me it’s great, as I had no effects of queasiness and I could play sitting down which was a bonus.  The graphics and sound are good with a variety of machines and people to kill, but be careful it’s not long before your guns overheat.  I only played to get first impressions,  I think this is a wave shooter so learning  enemy patterns is crucial and I do look forward to going through the campaign mode to see how far I can get in this demanding but fun game.
The game feels really good, it works perfectly on my quest and also it looks amazing.
LOVE IT!
It's a good game but it's solid on medium..wouldn't of liked to play the game before the update...but it is a good game at a fair price

First a warning for those who play seated or standing idle. You must be able to dodge and turn on your feet without using artificial turning. There is no seated play mode and no snap or smooth turning. This is a very physical game. In any game that supports it, I always play in roomscale using my feet to turn but I realize I’m in the minority, so I wanted to warn people.

It’s very difficult even on easy, but since the enemy attack patterns aren’t random it’s not hopelessly difficult

The day I bought it I went through these stages:

“This isn’t as hard as it looks in the trailer.”

“Oh man, I’m never going to get anywhere in this game, this is ridiculous.”

“Hey, I’m starting to get the hang of it!”

“I have to stop before my legs give out.”

I doubt I’ll ever have the skill to finish the game, but I’m going to have a lot of fun trying while getting some much needed exercise.

Despite the intense difficulty the developers do show some mercy by saving at check points that persist across play sessions.

Important Tip: After you shoot the start button, at the main menu turn left and read the wall for some helpful advice from the developers. What they don’t tell you on the wall is that your guns will fail regularly so you need to toss them away and grab a fresh set from your holsters. Also you can check your left wrist for your health status.

Aside from the campaign mode there’s an arcade mode that lets you play any planet you’ve completed in the campaign.

I love the art direction and on the Quest 3 the graphics are sharp and run at a steady frame rate. In a game that plays as fast as this, it’s important not to have performance issues adding to the difficulty.

Despite looking nothing like it Farcaster reminds me of Sega’s 80’s arcade classic Space Harrier. Space Harrier’s core strategy of “always keep moving and dodging” definitely applies here.  I’d suggest adding “toss your guns and grab new ones at every opportunity” to that strategy.

Many thanks to the developers for creating this intense arcade experience for such a reasonable price!
In a market full of shooters, Farcaster is a very nice find if you just want straight, fast-paced action. Just a couple of revolvers and tons of enemies. It runs and feels great.
Farcaster is a fun challenge that will test your aim and your quadriceps.

reviews.review_title: Thrilling Fusion of FPS and Arcade
reviews.review_description:
Farcaster is an action-packed game that skillfully combines classic FPS mechanics with the fast-paced excitement of on-rails action and wave shooting. Its polished gameplay ensures a thrilling experience, whether you’re blasting through waves of enemies or navigating dynamic, visually stunning environments. The arcade vibe, with its focus on high scores and replayability, adds a nostalgic yet fresh touch, making it a must-try for fans of action and shooter games.
It absolutely worth the price!
